metadata.name: ALDOT Airport Project Priority Rating System
metadata.agency: Alabama Department of Transportation, Aeronautics Bureau
metadata.source_citation: ALDOT Airport Project Priority Rating System. Encoded from source PDF at Priority_Model/Example Prioritization Models/ALDOT Airport Project Priority Rating System.pdf (extracted via OCR; project-type tables A–F are simplified to representative tiers).

decisions_log.author: APH m49 reference encoder
decisions_log.decision: Encoded ALDOT model as additive_100pt with three categories totaling 100
decisions_log.rationale: Source document explicitly: 'CATEGORY I — PROJECT TYPE (40 points) / Category II — Airport Usage (30 points) / Category III — Sponsor Responsibility (30 points)'.
decisions_log.source: ALDOT Airport Project Priority Rating System

decisions_log.author: APH m49 reference encoder
decisions_log.decision: Used flat_lookup scoring style for Project Type with 40+ subcategories representing the source's six lookup tables (A–F)
decisions_log.rationale: ALDOT's project-type scoring is a literal lookup table — each project type has a fixed point value with no further weighting.

criteria.label: Project Type
criteria.description: Granular lookup of project types into six sub-categories (Runways, Taxiways, Aprons, Landside Access, Land Acquisition, Other Infrastructure). Each project gets the highest applicable point value.

subcategories.label: Primary Runway — Remove approach area obstructions
subcategories.notes: State Licensing Standards, Part 77 and/or RPZ

criteria.label: Airport Usage
criteria.description: Based aircraft tier (most recent inspection). Engine selects the highest matching tier. Economic-development bonus is encoded as a separate adjustment.

criteria.label: Sponsor Responsibility
criteria.description: Compliance and stewardship responsibilities of the airport sponsor.

subcategories.label: Licensing — Partial compliance with corrective actions underway
Licensing — Non-compliance with no corrective actions
Minimum standards adopted and on file with ALDOT
Height zoning enacted and on file with ALDOT
Phased project with ALDOT priority and in current CIP
Project NOT supported by state system plan

governance.approval_process: Sponsors submit applications. ALDOT scores each project across the three categories. Airport classification (International, National, GA-Regional, GA-Community, Local) is reported alongside scores to illustrate funding distribution within each classification.

disclaimer: This model encoding is derived from the ALDOT Airport Project Priority Rating System. Project-type lookup tables A–F are encoded as a single flat_lookup; in implementation the engine should use field_match against project metadata.
